background.description: Color literal (#RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, 12 or 16 digit) or expression

dpi.description: Print resolution, stored in PNG and PDF files

bleed.description: Pixels cut off on every side; the trim line is this far inside

icons.description: Icons for {icon:name} in text with markup: an object of name to path, or a path with '*' for the name

import.description: Definitions files (*.defs.json) whose params and consts this design takes. The design's own params and consts of the same name replace them.

consts.description: Named values every layer can use, see https://yoshida.xoyz.dev/docs/expressions-constants-and-functions/#constants

additionalProperties.description: Number, true/false, an expression, or a list: an array of numbers, true/false or texts, or of objects with the same fields

args.description: Argument name to type, or a list of names (numbers)

expr.description: The expression; sees its arguments, params, constants and earlier functions

points.description: Polygon points: [x, y] pairs, and runs of points made from a count or a list. An object stands for a one-entry array

pointRun.description: One point per iteration of count or of each (a list), from x and y, which see the loop names

group.description: Editor section the param is shown in

default.description: Value an item gets when it leaves the field out

tag.description: Colour of the layer's row in the editor's layer list; never drawn

label.description: Divider: the title shown in the editor's layer list. Barcode: whether the human-readable text is drawn (true or false, or an expression)

rotate.description: Degrees clockwise around the anchor point (polygons: their centre)

anchor.description: One of the anchor names, or an expression that gives one

radius.description: blur: how far the picture spreads, in canvas pixels. Number literal or expression

x.description: shadow: horizontal offset in canvas pixels (default 0)

y.description: shadow: vertical offset in canvas pixels (default 4)

blur.description: shadow: how soft the edge is, in canvas pixels (default 6)

color.description: shadow: color, default black at half opacity (#00000080)

fill.description: Color literal (#RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, 12 or 16 digit) or expression

color.description: Color literal (#RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, 12 or 16 digit) or expression

dash.description: Dash pattern in pixels: on, off, ...

points.description: [x, y] pairs in canvas coordinates, mixed with point runs: { count or each, index, item, x, y } makes one point per iteration. An object alone is one run

color.description: Color literal (#RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, 12 or 16 digit) or expression

align.description: One of the align names, or an expression that gives one

max_width.description: Auto-shrink: reduce size until the block is at most this wide

max_height.description: Auto-shrink: reduce size until the block is at most this tall

fit.description: One of the fit names, or an expression that gives one

smoothing.description: or an expression that gives one

layers.description: Layers inside a group, first is bottom

arc.description: Part of the ellipse, degrees clockwise from the top

shape.description: A preset shape filling the box (instead of points)

count.description: Points of a star, sides of a polygon

inner.description: Star: inner radius; arrow: shaft; cross: arm; chevron: thickness (0 to 1)

translate.description: Moves the layers inside; their coordinates are relative to it

shrink_group.description: Texts with the same name use the smallest auto-shrunk size of all of them

gradient.description: Fill blended between colors across the layer (instead of fill)

angle.description: Linear: degrees clockwise, 0 from left to right

color.description: Color literal (#RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, 12 or 16 digit) or expression

clip.description: Clips the image to this polygon

layout.description: Places the children one after another; their own positions are replaced

align.description: Which end of the line sits at x (row) or y (column); or an expression that gives one

cross.description: Which side of every child sits at y (row) or x (column); or an expression that gives one

optional.description: Image: a missing file hides the layer instead of being an error

markup.description: Text: <b>, <i> and {icon:name} in the text are markup

include.description: Group: takes the layers from a component file instead of "layers"

id_prefix.description: Group with include: put this text in front of the id of every layer of the component (and of its @id references), so the component can be included more than once

text.description: What the code holds: text with {expression} placeholders, for example a link

box.description: The code is drawn as a square with whole pixels per module, centred in this box

color.description: Color of the dark modules. Default black

fill.description: Color behind the code, quiet zone included. Default white; #00000000 for none

margin.description: Quiet zone around the code in modules, 0 to 16. Default 4

level.description: Error correction: low (7%), medium (15%, default), quartile (25%) or high (30%); or an expression that gives one

mode.description: QR only: how the text is cut into segments: auto (fewest bits), byte, numeric or alphanumeric. Default byte; or an expression that gives one

style.description: Shape of the data modules: square (default), rounded or dots; or an expression that gives one

eye.description: Shape of the three corner squares: square (default), rounded or circle; or an expression that gives one

eye_color.description: Color of the corner squares. Default: the color of the code

logo.description: Clears a square in the middle for a logo, as a share of the code's side, 0 to 0.5. Use level high

logo_src.description: Picture drawn in the cleared middle: a path with {expression} placeholders, like an image's src. Clears a fifth of the side unless logo is set

format.description: The kind of code: qr, code128, ean13, ean8, upca, code39, itf, itf14, codabar, code93, datamatrix, aztec or pdf417; or an expression that gives one

check.description: Check digit: auto (add a missing one, reject a wrong one; default), add (also append the optional check of code39 and itf) or none; or an expression that gives one

label.description: Linear codes: draw the human-readable text under the bars (true or false, or an expression). Default: on for ean13, ean8, upca and itf14, off for the others

label_text.description: Linear codes: text shown instead of the encoded text, with {expression} placeholders

label_color.description: Linear codes: color of the text. Default: the color of the bars

label_gap.description: Linear codes: space between bars and text in pixels. Default a quarter of the text size

font.description: Linear codes: the font of the text, a name from "fonts". Default: the default font

size.description: Linear codes: text size in pixels. Default eight modules, at most 30% of the box height, shrunk to fit the bars

align.description: Linear codes: where the text sits under the bars: left, center (default), right or justify (spread over the bars); or an expression that gives one

text.description: What the code holds: text with {expression} placeholders, for example a link or the digits of an EAN

box.description: The code is drawn with whole pixels per module, centred in this box. A 1D code is as wide as the box allows and as high as the box (label included); a QR code is a square

color.description: Color of the dark modules. Default black

fill.description: Color behind the code, quiet zone included. Default white; #00000000 for none

margin.description: Quiet zone around the code in modules, 0 to 16. Default: what the format asks for (QR 4, 1D codes 7 to 11, Data Matrix and PDF417 2, Aztec 1). 1D codes get it left and right only

level.description: QR only. Error correction: low (7%), medium (15%, default), quartile (25%) or high (30%); or an expression that gives one

mode.description: QR only: how the text is cut into segments: auto (fewest bits), byte, numeric or alphanumeric. Default auto; or an expression that gives one

ecc.description: Aztec: the least share of error correction in percent of the data, 0 to 90 (default 23). PDF417: error correction level 0 to 8 (default: by size)

style.description: Shape of the data modules: square (default), rounded or dots; or an expression that gives one

eye.description: Shape of the three corner squares: square (default), rounded or circle; or an expression that gives one

eye_color.description: Color of the corner squares. Default: the color of the code

logo.description: Clears a square in the middle for a logo, as a share of the code's side, 0 to 0.5. Use level high

logo_src.description: Picture drawn in the cleared middle: a path with {expression} placeholders, like an image's src. Clears a fifth of the side unless logo is set

translate.description: Moves the layers inside; their coordinates are relative to it

layout.description: Places the children one after another; their own positions are replaced

align.description: Which end of the line sits at x (row) or y (column); or an expression that gives one

cross.description: Which side of every child sits at y (row) or x (column); or an expression that gives one

include.description: Takes the layers from a component file (a path from the project folder) instead of "layers"

id_prefix.description: With include: text put in front of the ids of the component's layers
